The terms 2/10, n/30 mean a 2% discount is available if paid within 10 days, otherwise the net amount is due in 30 days.  
The invoice date is August 4, payment date is August 13, which is within 10 days, so the discount applies.  
2% of $7,000 = $140, so payment = $7,000 − $140 = $6,860.  

Final answer: (C)
